_doc: PROPOSAL (task M3-01, second run), not game data: the pacing simulator's redesign model reads this folder, the game does not. It follows design spec sections 1-14 and the lead's decisions in section 16: cubes come only from Lumi's own loads and bales and from city stage payouts (robots earn none); Parts buy robots, upgrades, rig modules and the rocket; seeds pay for planting and for the cleansing plants that clear blight. Global numbers for the Planet 1 redesign. All times are BOT seconds unless a field says otherwise; a new player is bot_to_player times slower at actions (growth timers are real time for both), and every cadence limit is checked on the player's clock. planet_id: the planet whose unchanged tables are read through Planets (litter value mix from 'pollution', perfect-press multiplier from 'player'). target_bot_min: the bot's target time to the launch point and the accepted range. start.delay_s: seconds from gaining control to the first sweep. hand: baler_unlock = the id that turns loose tipping into pressing bales; base_rate = units of litter swept a second before any bonus; capacity = chest size in units; tip_s = one walk to the bin and back to tip a loose load; press_s = pressing one bale; carry_s = one walk to the scale with a stack of carry_stack bales; loose_mult = payout multiplier for loose trash tipped in the bin (1.0); bale_mult_worst = the payout multiplier of the worst bale a player can press (a perfect bale pays the planet's perfect multiplier, 1.5): it must stay above loose_mult so any pressed bale pays more than tipping; shop_s = seconds one purchase costs at the bench. mastery: level L needs mastery_level1_units (per kind, pollution.json) x growth^(L-1) units of that kind cleared by hand in total; hand_bonus_per_level is Lumi's rate bonus per level; unlock = the id that starts mastery. surge: unlock id (research in city 4, where it arrives together with its growth wave); charge_s = seconds of hand work (sweeping, pressing, tending) for a full charge; duration_s and mult = the burst; wave = a release also adds burst_pts growth points to `hexes` hexes of the district. The Surge is a moment, not a counted power spike.
